ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:9 high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity contiguous region located on the extreme lateral margin of the left lobe. Multiple discrete, sub-circular high-intensity focal points scattered across the medial and lateral dark regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped indentation with an approximate angle of 85 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature from the median notch extending toward the tips, transitioning into high-irregularity zones at the lateral boundaries due to surface anomalies.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes. Small, isolated white circular points visible in the central and lateral dark regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-colored linear disruptions visible on the right lobe, including a series of short, roughly parallel diagonal marks near the mid-trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes, significantly altering the geometric boundary of the fluke extremities.
